title: Allowing Ambulances to Run Red Lights in Emergencies
what_it_is: Allowing Ambulances to Run Red Lights in Emergencies

sections.label: Ambulances running red lights
sections.summary: The law does not expressly allow ambulances to run red lights, but SCDF officers have discretion in life-threatening emergencies.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Today, the law does not expressly provide for ambulances to run red lights in an emergency.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: However, SCDF officers are given the discretion to do so when responding to life-threatening emergencies, such as cardiac arrest and stroke, where every second counts.

sections.label: Ambulance driver red-light procedure
sections.summary: An ambulance driver running a red light or making an unauthorised U-turn must sound the siren, activate blinkers, slow down and halt.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: An ambulance driver who intends to run a red light or make an unauthorised U-turn is required to sound the siren and activate the blinker lights to alert other road users.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: When approaching the traffic junction, the driver must slow down and come to a complete halt, so that he can make a situational assessment of the traffic conditions before proceeding further.

sections.label: Exempting SCDF ambulances
sections.summary: MHA is working towards exempting SCDF's ambulances from the legislative provision prohibiting red-light running and unauthorised U-turns.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: To this end, MHA is working towards exempting SCDF's ambulances from the legislative provision that prohibits red-light running and unauthorised U-turns.

sections.label: Updating Highway Code
sections.summary: MHA is updating the Highway Code to include pointers on how motorists should respond to emergency vehicles.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: MHA is updating the Highway Code to include pointers on how motorists should respond when they encounter emergency vehicles.

sections.label: Penalties for refusing way
sections.summary: Motorists who refuse to give way to emergency vehicles are liable for four demerit points and a composition fine.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Motorists who refuse to give way to emergency vehicles are liable for four demerit points and a composition fine.

sections.label: Including fire engines and Police
sections.summary: Fire engines and the Police will be included in the review.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: Yes, we will include fire engines and the Police in the review.
